title: Higher Finiteness Embeddings and TDLC Analogues
exact_target: Does every finitely presented group embed in a group of type $F_3$? Does every group of type $\mathrm{FP}_2$ embed in a group of type $\mathrm{FP}_3$? Formulate and prove, or disprove, a totally disconnected locally compact analogue of the intended embedding theorem.
